title: Chapter 222
text:
In the tent in the center of the camp, Han Xiao looked at the blueprint on the table and thought about how to use the players' advantage.

His mission quota had increased. The highest reward for a single mission was a little over 60,000 experience points, which was still a little short of 80,000 experience points. The total daily quota was seven times that of a single mission, which meant that he could assign missions with a total of 420,000 experience points each day. He realized that the easiest way to increase his quota was to open up factions and gain favorability. Levels and grades were natural, and Legendary Points were something that could only be found.

The quota did not cost his own experience points.

For such a big mission like building a city, his quota alone was not enough. Therefore, Han Xiao thought about it and decided on a way to assign missions. That was to separate the construction of the Graymetal Ruins into different departments and set up a person in charge. The players could go to the person in charge to receive work (mission) without using up his own quota.

Building Sanctuary Three was a main storyline. If he could assign missions to the players, then logically, the other NPCs in the team could do it too.

This should solve the limit of the mission quota. The other NPCs don't have an interface, but since they are part of the city-building team, it should be fine to assign missions.

Letting the other NPCs assign missions on his behalf would not only avoid the limit of his quota, but it would also be helpful to his own mission. Since the mission he got was a unified one, the final result of the players' construction would be the result of his mission. The difference between the two missions came from their different identities. Han Xiao was the person in charge of the sanctuary, which was his advantage.

Han Xiao suddenly had a new idea. If he encountered such a big mission next time, he could replicate this experience and use his advantage as an NPC to get a higher faction relationship. He could then become the mission issuer and use the strength of the players to achieve his goal.

This way, I only need to manage the person in charge and can plan the overall situation. I can be a hands-off boss and use my free time to build machinery to reach the five purple equipment requirement. Han Xiao nodded to himself. It was perfect that he could do the main storyline and have time for his own development.

This was not a trap for the players. The players could also do missions and gain benefits. Their participation in the construction of the city could build a cohesive force. Once the sanctuary was built, all the participants would have a sense of achievement and pride. "This is a city built by us players."

It was a win-win situation!

Han Xiao had a bold idea.

"Maybe I can turn this Sanctuary into something similar to a player's main city. This will have an unparalleled effect on my influence. Everyone who comes to the Sanctuary will see my name!"

After finalizing the details, he gathered the construction team and the guards for a meeting.

"Where's Liu Zhao? Why isn't he here for the meeting?" Han Xiao glanced around.

Everyone did not react for a moment. Someone cautiously said, "You sent him out to contact the rogues …"

"Nonsense, how could I forget?"

Han Xiao glared. Before everyone could react, he coughed dryly and said seriously, "Building a shelter from scratch is a huge project. I have divided the blueprint construction into thirteen departments. This is the information. It covers construction, exploration, and so on. Each department has a person in charge. My goal is to complete the blueprint construction as soon as possible. It would be best if I could shorten the time to within a month."

"We don't have that many people, and we don't even have enough mutants outside …" someone said.

"Don't worry about that. There will be more people sooner or later." Han Xiao knocked on the table and emphasized. "Is everyone clear?"

Everyone could only nod. One month was too much of a rush, but since it was a request from their boss, they could only try their best. Otherwise, they would not be able to bear the consequences. Although Han Xiao was still kind, no one forgot that he was the strongest person in the organization. He was a legend who had killed countless people, and he was currently the number one assassin.

Han Xiao announced the person in charge, and Huang Yu was not part of it.

Huang Yu was quite happy. He had nothing to do. Although thousands of mutants came, it was still a drop in the bucket. It was impossible to complete the prototype in a month. In the end, Sanctuary Three could only be completed in a few months. By that time, Sanctuary One would have been completed. As an assistant, he did not have many benefits, so he did not plan to help.

Huang Yu had just told Bennett about the mutants coming to help Han Xiao. Bennett was very calm and did not have any opinions about it. It could be seen that Bennett trusted Black Phantom a lot, and the two had a very good relationship. Huang Yu also roughly understood why Bennett sent him as an assistant. It was to choose a capable assistant to help his friend.

"It's all because I'm too good." Huang Yu sighed helplessly.

The meeting came to an end. Han Xiao had already explained the affairs of each department clearly. In the end, his face became very serious. He said in a deep voice, "I've said everything that needs to be said. Now, there is a very urgent mission that must be done first."

Seeing Han Xiao's serious expression, everyone became nervous.

Looking around, Han Xiao said seriously, "Write down the name of the sanctuary first. Remember to use my name."

Everyone's tense expression suddenly collapsed.

…

The people in charge of each department left the camp. According to Han Xiao's instructions, they organized the people in an orderly manner. The players who had been waiting for a long time immediately gathered around and chose different jobs according to their preferences, triggering different city-building missions.

Graymetal Ruins was divided into five areas — North, South, East, West, and Central. The missions given to the players were also divided into different areas.

After receiving the missions, the players immediately formed teams and looked for people to do the missions together. It was even livelier at night than during the day.

The first and most important task was to expel the beasts and clean up the ruins. Only then could they carry out the various constructions. With the stadium as the center, the players spread out and scattered to the various areas of Graymetal Ruins.

Gunshots could be heard from time to time. There were many beasts living in Graymetal Ruins, so the players had plenty of chances to fight.

These construction missions could be done repeatedly, and the rewards were quite good. The interface also notified the players that they were building Sanctuary Three. After success, they would receive a huge amount of extra experience, so they were even more excited.

Black Phantom Sanctuary Three. The name of this city had 'Black Phantom' in it, so the players had a deeper impression of Han Xiao.

The shelter had a person's name on it, and it sounded very impressive.

On the first night, the players cleaned up a large area, and the efficiency shocked the people of the Dark Net. This was comparable to the speed of ten thousand workers!

The players were all Supers, so their work abilities were enhanced. With the help of the interface, it was clear what to do with the missions, and their goals were very clear.

When the players and the Dark Net construction team were in full swing, Han Xiao received a call from Maple Moon. He had left the mission for Maple Moon to find him when she was at level 20. He remembered and brought her to the camp.

They had not seen each other for a while, so Maple Moon looked around curiously. Han Xiao also called the other three guys over. He was going to give the four of them some extra missions.

The four backups finally met. With Han Xiao's current ability, it was more than enough to train four players. Mad Blade and Hao Tian, two pro gods in his previous life. Now, one was a Mechanical Pugilist, and the other was a Pugilist. Maple Moon, one of the first Mechanics to rise in his previous life. Pork Bun, Beat Dog, a famous video host.

The four of them had their own specialties and could help in different ways. They all stood in front of Han Xiao and sized each other up.

As the only female player, Maple Moon received special treatment. The other three nodded to her to show their goodwill.

"Ah, so cute." Maple Moon stared at Hao Tian with shining eyes. She looked like she was going to eat him alive.

Sweat appeared on Hao Tian's forehead. He stood straight and did not move. He watched as Maple Moon ran into his arms … or more accurately, he hugged Bear Cub and rubbed it lovingly.

Bear Cub was confused the whole time. It shrunk into Hao Tian's arms and bit Maple Moon's finger a few times.

"Ahhh, so cute!" Maple Moon's eyes lit up. She looked up and begged, "God, can you let me hug it?"

"Be clearer next time." Hao Tian's face stiffened. He could not wait to pass Bear Cub to Maple Moon. He took two steps back and felt relieved.

Bun-Hit-Dog also came over and reached out to tease Bear Cub. Bear Cub was stupid and cute, and its reaction was always half a beat slower. Its chubby paws kept slapping away the big hands that were kneading its butt. Beside him, Frenzied Sword kept his eyes on Han Xiao, looking like he was waiting for orders at any time.

"Okay, okay, stop playing with my bear." Han Xiao coughed and interrupted them. "I'm building a shelter. You guys go and help." As he said that, he set an extra mission for the four of them. If they completed a certain number of missions from the department heads, they would receive extra rewards.

The other players did not have this privilege. These four players were his own people, so Han Xiao was willing to train them.

The four of them naturally did not have any objections. They accepted the mission and left. Maple Moon, however, stayed behind and asked carefully, "Can I learn skills?"

Han Xiao nodded and opened the interface for her. He could teach these four players any skills at any time. Other than the trump cards, the rest could be used to earn experience.

Maple Moon also walked the path of a Mechanic, so he could train her as a disciple. Maple Moon was a casual player and liked life style games. It was worth it to train her as an assistant. Han Xiao was not stingy, and he had a good impression of Maple Moon.

In his previous life, the Great Mechanic Han, who was still a newbie, had started playing since Version 1.0. He had also chosen the Mechanic class, and he had also had the experience of losing repeatedly in PvP battles. At one point, he had given up on the Mechanic class, and if it was not because he liked it, he would have changed his account. In the professional arena in Version 3.0, Maple Moon, who participated in the competition for the first time, became a dark horse. She represented the rise of the Mechanic class and gave Han Xiao a lot of encouragement. When he was young, he had even been a fan of Maple Moon for a while.

Later on, he became more and more skilled and gradually became one of the representative experts of the Mechanic class. Although he was not a professional player, the legend of Han Technician spread throughout the game. The players on the forums often discussed the rankings of the players who participated in the Pro League. Han Technician was a hot topic that had not died down for a long time.

Han Technician became stronger and stronger, but Maple Moon was like a comet, leaving a mark on the milestones of the game but quickly falling silent. She only shone in the third and fourth versions. After all, Maple Moon was a casual player, and her PK skills improved slowly. Not everyone was as interested in a game as Han Technician.

In the later versions, Maple Moon almost disappeared from the professional scene. It was said that she had terminated her contract with the club. Her light was only left in the memories of the old players.

The Maple Moon in front of him was cute and delicate. It was hard to associate her with the figure in his memory. Looking at Maple Moon, who was struggling to choose a skill, Han Xiaoxin had mixed feelings.

"I wonder what will happen this time?"
